subject: Re: Scheduling hold — security packet + exec travel window (Acadia Health)
messages:
From: Emma Brooks <emma.brooks@acadiahealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acadiahealth.com>
Date: 2028-09-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Technical demo - Acadia Health / Redwood

Hi Irene,

Quick heads up — procurement and our InfoSec team just reviewed the upcoming demo request and flagged two gating items they need completed before we can host a live executive demo: 1) a completed security packet (they attached the form) and 2) confirmation of the exec travel window (our CISO and the VP of Product will be traveling next week). Because of that travel, they want us to hold off on scheduling the full exec demo until the week of 9/25 or later.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide:
- the standard supplier security packet (PDF questionnaire) filled out by the vendor
- SOC 2 report (if available) or evidence of equivalent controls
- a signed NDA (they prefer DocuSign)

I've attached the security packet they're requesting (Acadia_Security_Request_Form.pdf). Procurement also suggested a short vendor intake call with their security reviewer if you think that will help speed things up.

Sorry for the curveball — we want to keep momentum but procurement has to clear these items. Please let me know what you can share this week and whether a narrow procurement-only call makes sense.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Brooks
Director, Product Operations
Acadia Health

Attachment: Acadia_Security_Request_Form.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Emma Brooks <emma.brooks@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-08T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical demo - Acadia Health / Redwood

Emma — thanks for the clarity and for sending the packet. We've hit these gates before and can move quickly, so pausing the exec demo until your team is comfortable makes sense.

Immediate next steps from our side:
- I've attached a signed copy of our standard NDA (NDA_Redwood_signed.pdf) and can route a DocuSign link if Acadia prefers that workflow.
- Ben will take point on the security packet and SOC2 evidence; he should be able to return a completed questionnaire draft within 3 business days.
- If helpful, we can do a 30-minute intake call with your InfoSec reviewer to walk through any outstanding questions.

Would your team prefer a procurement-only call this week (30 min) or next week? Also — please confirm the latest date your execs will be unavailable due to travel so we can propose concrete demo windows.

I'll leave Ben and Hannah on thread to coordinate timing.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Attachment: NDA_Redwood_signed.pdf

From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acadiahealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Emma Brooks <emma.brooks@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: Acadia IT Security <infosec@acadiahealth.com>
Date: 2028-09-09T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical demo - Acadia Health / Redwood

Thanks Irene — appreciate the quick reply. Procurement / IT Security prefer the vendor to fill the supplier questionnaire in our vendor portal (we sent an invite to the vendor email you provided earlier), and they do need either our standard SOC2 report or an attestation that equivalent controls exist. If Redwood can provide the SOC2, that will shorten review substantially.

Our execs are out until 2028-09-25; the earliest practical date for an exec-level demo is the week of 9/25. That said, procurement is open to a separate procurement-only session as you suggested to review the completed packet and talk through any gaps — that could happen as early as this coming Thursday morning (9/12) or next Monday (9/16).

I've attached a procurement checklist we use (procurement_checklist.xlsx) for visibility. We can re-open DocuSign for the NDA once we have the security packet and SOC2/attestation uploaded.

Liam
Liam O'Neill
Senior Buyer, Strategic Procurement
Acadia Health

Attachment: procurement_checklist.xlsx

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>

Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Technical demo - Acadia Health / Redwood

Liam / Emma — thanks for the timing. Ben will handle the vendor questionnaire and SOC2 upload; he plans to complete the vendor packet by EOD Friday (9/12).

Proposed plan to keep momentum without blocking exec calendars:
- 1) Procurement-only call (30 min) this Thursday 9/12 at 10:00 AM PT to walk through the packet and address any clarifying questions from InfoSec. If that works, Ben will join and have the draft packet live during the call.
- 2) Once procurement confirms the packet is in good shape and we upload SOC2, we re-open DocuSign for NDA and target an exec-run demo the week of 9/25. Our suggested demo windows are included in the .ics attachment (proposed_demo_windows.ics) — we can lock to 9/27 or 10/02 depending on final exec availability.

If Acadia wants, we can also run a short non-exec technical preview (30 min) for power users earlier to demonstrate the platform capabilities without execs. That keeps technical stakeholders engaged while procurement runs their checks.

Ben — please confirm you can have the packet draft ready by EOD Friday and upload SOC2 by then if available.

Thanks,
Hannah
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_demo_windows.ics

From: Emma Brooks <emma.brooks@acadiahealth.com>

Hannah / Ben / Irene — that sounds good. Procurement can do the 9/12 procurement-only call at 10:00 AM PT; I asked InfoSec to join as well. Liam — please send the portal invite to Ben if not already sent.

Once we receive the completed packet and SOC2, we'll re-open DocuSign and confirm an exec slot the week of 9/25. If Ben has any questions while filling the questionnaire, route them to infosec@acadiahealth.com and copy me.

Appreciate the quick response and the alternative preview idea — helps keep our technical stakeholders engaged.

Best,
Emma
